name: MegaRobotics M40WS
summary: A compact wheel-legged quadruped of 42 kg from the German MegaRobotics brand, built by an OEM partner, with 190 mm wheels, folding legs, 40 kg payload on flat ground and IP66. Meant for inspection in narrow aisles, plant rooms and multi-level sites outside Ex zones.

germany.statusNote: Sold by MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH, Kaarst) as its own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner; "Sourcing on request", "Inquiry only", price on request. The page says CE conformity is in preparation.

sellers.note: "Contact for pricing"; own brand for the DACH region: "MegaRobotics supplies, integrates and services the M40WS in the DACH region, built by an OEM manufacturing partner." CE conformity is in preparation.
